skill.displayName: AI Text Remover from Video – Remove Text from Video Online Free – API-powered
skill.summary: AI text remover from video — remove text overlays or watermarks from a video

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of ai-text-remover-from-video-openapi-skill.
- Allows automatic removal of text overlays or watermarks from videos using the WeShop AI API.
- Requires a WESHOP_API_KEY (environment variable supported).
- Includes endpoints for starting and monitoring runs, plus image upload.
- Security guidance included to protect API keys.
- Supports simple input (video URL) and auto-detection of watermarks.
